justification: NHANES exam missingness (BMI 8.5%, waist 12.3%, BP 17.5%) is likely MAR (exam non-completion correlates with health status). MICE preserves multivariate relationships and is unbiased under MAR. Median imputation would distort BP variance and BMI-waist correlation.
reference: Madley-Dowd et al. BMJ 2019; White et al. Stat Med 2011
